_forwardCompatNotes: commerce.payment.razorpay.keyId is the PUBLIC key id (rzp_test_/rzp_live_); the key secret + webhook secret come from the operator env (PROVISION_RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET / PROVISION_RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET) at provision time. To enable online payment add "razorpay" to enabledProviders. Reserved for future phases (ignored by v1 provisioning, additive — never remove existing keys): store.domains[] for custom domains; tenancy{enabled,strategy} for tenant routing; admin -> admins[] for multiple admins; notifications.email{} for merchant email; commerce.payment.stripe{} for Stripe. Secrets NEVER belong in this file.
